detailed_descriptions_html.en:
A custom crosshair for every game you play

Crosshair X overlays your own custom crosshair on top of any game you play, even games that do not include one. Improve your aim and accuracy in first-person shooters, third-person shooters, battle royales, survival games, and anything else you play on PC.

Rated Very Positive with over 41,000 reviews on Steam, Crosshair X is the most popular crosshair overlay on PC.

Features

  • Thousands of community designs. Browse and download crosshairs shared by the Crosshair X community, with new designs added every day.

  • Precision designer. Build your own crosshair from scratch with controls for lines, dot, outline, color, opacity, and animations. Upload any image to use as your crosshair.

  • Works in every game. Compatible with first-person shooters, third-person games, survival titles, and single-player adventures.

  • Exclusive fullscreen support. Show your crosshair even in games that block third-party overlays, through the official Xbox Game Bar.

  • Steam Workshop. Subscribe to crosshairs from the Steam Workshop and publish your own designs.

  • Multi-monitor support. Choose which monitor to display the crosshair on, and save the crosshair position for each game.

  • Save and switch. Save unlimited crosshairs and switch between them in seconds.

  • Smart toggle. Show or hide your crosshair with a custom keyboard shortcut, or hide it automatically when you right-click to aim down sights.

  • Share with friends. Share any crosshair with a single code, or export it as an image file.

Available in 17 languages. English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Turkish, Polish, Swedish, Czech, Danish, and Ukrainian.
